name: web-to-obsidian
description: Capture browser sources into a local Obsidian vault and configure safe formatting for the resulting web clips.

interface.shortDescription: Capture and format web sources in Obsidian.
interface.longDescription: Two focused workflows for saving a browser tab, selection, or public URL into a local Obsidian vault and configuring safe Markdown formatting, scoped CSS, and export preparation for captured web notes.
defaultPrompt: Save the current browser tab to my Obsidian vault.
Save my selected text and preserve its source URL.
Set up safe formatting for web clips in my Obsidian vault.
